page-structure.evidence: Title 'Gymshark Power Straight Leg Pants - GS Black/GS Asphalt Grey | Gymshark' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). axe aria-hidden-focus SERIOUS: 8 slick-carousel slide divs with aria-hidden='true' contain focusable elements (2 each) — focus can land on aria-hidden content, creating ghost tab stops invisible to AT.

tabWalk.offScreenStops=4 — four 'Pause slide rotation' buttons are off-screen (not inViewport) yet receive Tab focus (global tab walk). Off-screen focusables create 2.4.11 (Focus Not Obscured) issues.
